caveats.failsafe_labels: labels set after a first run that used other labels, matched to the library's altitude-ceiling-hold labelling (E5); the 35/35 fail-safe figure is not pre-registered and is not an independent fail-safe KPI result
caveats.scope: headless only: no rail passes a ground; a DEM Shield requires up_ref='terrain' and the rails' State.up is height above home; the DEM is synthetic and metre-framed (origin null); no SITL, hil or PAS flight has carried an MSL rule
